subject: Copywriting
subcategory: The Science of Storytelling in Ads
title: Emotional Ads Outperform Rational Ones
description: A quick, practical guide to Emotional Ads Outperform Rational Ones.

hook.text: The IPA database of 1,400 ad campaigns proves that purely emotional ads are twice as profitable as purely rational ones.

buildup.text: Binet and Field analyzed 30 years of data.

discovery.text: Rational ads work for short-term activation: 'Buy now, 20% off.' Emotional ads build brand equity that compounds.

twist.text: The optimal mix is 60% emotional brand-building and 40% rational activation. Neither alone maximizes return.

climax.text: John Lewis Christmas ads in the UK invest purely in emotion. They consistently drive the highest sales of the year.

punchline.text: 60% emotion, 40% logic. The data says feel first, think second.

quiz.question: What is the optimal mix of emotional to rational advertising?
